_authoring_notes: No 'critical' tier is encoded: the literature supports a single 20-25 C favourable band and a 15-30 C plausible-activity band, with nothing distinguishing a more-severe-than-high tier; the PDM weather-rule ruleset for this pest reaches the same three tiers.
Humidity (hum_lo/hum_hi) is set to the full 0-100 range on every rule, i.e. deliberately non-discriminating: the sign of the humidity effect is contested in the field literature.

rain_min is 0.0 on every rule, i.e. precipitation never raises fuzzy membership for any band. The engine's rain_min mechanism can only require a minimum rainfall for a rule to gain strength, which does not fit an aphid.
t_lethal_min=-5.0 C is an assumption, not literature-sourced: no source gives a lower lethal bound for B. brassicae; -5.0 C follows the insect-template convention (Bactrocera oleae uses -5.0 C).
t_lethal_max=35.0 C: no development was recorded at 35 C in a single-clone, constant-temperature lab trial (Soh et al. 2018), treated as a cautious upper bound.
t_optimal_min/max = 20.0/25.0 C from the adopted favourable/high-pressure band, narrowed to exclude 30 C because of the r_m reversal reported by Soh et al. 2018.
min_streak=2 and min_wetness_hours_critical/high=24.0 are inherited unchanged from the insect-template convention (Cydia pomonella and Bactrocera oleae use these values), not separately sourced.

No pheno_lo/pheno_hi/pheno_frac_* fields are set: no canonical generations-per-season figure for BRVCBR was found (15-20 generations per crop cycle in Argentina against 30 or more per year in warm climates).
No agronomist review has been made of this definition yet.
